survey: A fruit still life: a shallow clear glass plate sits on a wooden tabletop seen from slightly above (about 15°). The table's back edge is horizontal and the plank seams spread out toward the viewer, meeting at one vanishing point above the picture. The plate is one smooth ellipse (height about 0.25 of its width) lying flat on the table near its back edge. On the plate, a watermelon wedge stands upright at the back, flesh facing the camera, with the rind turning away at the right. Two orange wedges lie on their sides at the right, their cut faces leaning back and foreshortened by the same amount. A bunch of green grapes with a leaf and stem sits at the left, two strawberries in the middle, and three blueberries at the front whose crowns are seen slightly from above. All the fruit rests on the plate floor. The front strawberry overlaps the front rim but sits behind the glass. Every part agrees with one slightly-high camera.
